D2 SSH agent crash — live investigation with explicit user authorization (record-only rule lifted for this one item, no source edits committed)
completed_tasks.result: Confirmed root cause via live repro: raw tokio::spawn at ssh_agent_service.rs:138 panics ("there is no reactor running") because it's called from Tauri's native main/webview thread with no ambient Tokio reactor — both from .setup() at boot and the synchronous update_ssh_agent_enabled command. Same panic explains both the clean exit-101 seen this run and the earlier 0xc0000409 fastfail crash-loop (timing-dependent UB unwinding across the native GUI/WebView2 FFI boundary). Fix identified (swap to tauri::async_runtime::spawn) and verified to compile clean in a throwaway edit, but NOT committed — reverted, per record-only default. Findings doc D2 row updated with full writeup.

blockers.description: SSH Agent toggle in Settings crashes pwmgr-app.exe. Root cause now confirmed (raw tokio::spawn panic at ssh_agent_service.rs:138, no ambient Tokio reactor on Tauri's native thread) but not fixed in source.
blockers.workaround: Keep ssh_agent_enabled: false in ~/.pwmgr/config.json. Do not toggle SSH Agent on in Settings until D2 is resolved.

blockers.description: viewer-src-tauri's documented dev-launch command (npx tauri dev from inside viewer-src-tauri) fails because beforeDevCommand runs with the wrong cwd.
